title: StackKit operation denial v1
description: Fail-closed admission denial carried as data of a stackkit.command-result/v1 envelope with status denied. It is written before any side effect. reasonCode is stable and machine-readable (the catalog docs/data/advanced-operations/latest.json lists the codes); message is diagnostic and must not be used as a policy input.

operation.description: The denied operation: a capability operation ID such as terramate.change-set.create or restore.drill, or drift-reconcile for `stackkit drift reconcile`.
